subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add an opt-in sibling-mention suppression gate, and should it mirror Slack/Discord `ignoreOtherMentions` or use a Matrix-specific policy shape?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a config/default and changing dispatch suppression semantics can affect existing always-on Matrix rooms, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Add Matrix `ignoreOtherMentions` parity
options.body: Introduce a default-off Matrix room/account option modeled on Slack and Discord, with Matrix-specific mention parsing for configured sibling accounts and focused monitor tests.

options.title: Defer to broader multi-bot routing
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers settle a cross-channel single-target routing model that also covers Discord reply-target precedence and Matrix outbound mention metadata.

options.title: Decline new Matrix gate
options.body: Document `requireMention` and prompt-based workarounds as the supported behavior, accepting extra dispatch cost in always-on multi-account rooms.

recommendation.title: Add Matrix `ignoreOtherMentions` parity
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-off Matrix room/account option modeled on Slack and Discord, with Matrix-specific mention parsing for configured sibling accounts and focused monitor tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing Matrix bot-to-bot policy and related maintainer discussion trace most directly to this owner.
